notes.title: Weeny Wise Release Date Revealed at the BIG Fall Showcase
notes.notes:
[p]During the [b]BIG Fall Showcase[/b], the release date trailer for [b]Weeny Wise[/b] was officially unveiled, and we’re excited to announce that we’ll be joining you and your companion on [b]February 18, 2026[/b]!

[/p][previewyoutube="z2Zc0DTDW1o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s been a full year since our last trailer, and during that time we’ve been working hard, learning, experimenting, and implementing bold new ideas! all with one goal in mind: to create a truly unforgettable [b]co-op adventure[/b].
[/p][p]This journey hasn’t been easy, but your support and enthusiasm mean everything to us. That’s why we’d love for you to keep cheering us on, so we can continue building [b]Weeny Wise[/b] with even more passion and determination🍄💖
[/p][p]We sincerely hope you’ll enjoy the new trailer, and we can’t wait to share even more exciting updates with you in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][p]Mark your calendars for [b]February 18, 2026[/b], and get ready to step into the magical world of [b]Weeny Wise[/b] with your companion by your side.[/p]

notes.title: Weeny Wise Hits 10K Wishlists, Thanks to You!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Weeny Wise has reached an incredible milestone of 10,000 wishlists on Steam! This achievement comes after a year of launching our Steam page, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the support we’ve received.

[previewyoutube=hepdnX1EySo;full][/previewyoutube]

What makes this milestone even more special is that we didn’t run any major advertising campaigns. Instead, we achieved this through organic growth, with a huge thanks to our loyal community and the support of our media partners. It’s truly been a grassroots effort, and we couldn’t have done it without you!

Currently, we are in the alpha development stage of the game, and we’re working hard to bring you the best possible experience. In the near future, we’ll be releasing more details about Weeny Wise that are sure to surprise and excite our fans.

Thank you all for your incredible support – we can’t wait to share more with you soon!

notes.title: A demo of Weeny Wise for the Speed WIZ competition is now available!
notes.notes:
As of September 23rd, a demo of Weeny Wise has been made available, created specifically for the Speed WIZ competition.

Speed WIZ is a free speedrun competition with prizes, designed for fans of speedrun challenges. This version is built from pre-alpha assets and does not represent the final game or the story mode demo.

The demo offers 15 minutes of gameplay, where players take on the roles of Anneli and Hogo, working together to overcome puzzle and platforming challenges and reach the end of the game.

Watch as our game director and one of the developers take on the intense platforming challenge at the start of the #SpeedWIZ demo! 🎮🔥
[previewyoutube=aXAZczqSuiU;full][/previewyoutube]

The top 3 teams with the best completion times will win Steam gift cards:

1st Place: €50 Steam Gift Card
2nd Place: €30 Steam Gift Card
3rd Place: €20 Steam Gift Card

The demo also includes a training mode, allowing players who don’t wish to compete to test the gameplay without registering.

Please note that this version only supports local co-op.

Those interested in participating in the competition can register via the link below and start setting records until the competition ends on September 30th. Players can attempt the game as many times as they want to improve their times.

notes.title: Devlog #2 | From Pre-Alpha To Demo
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the devlog we released  in early May. In that devlog, we explained our journey from the beginning to reaching the pre-alpha version, a path that had a beautiful ending as we managed to be nominated among the top 50 games out of 200 registered for the Digital Dragons event, allowing us to participate in the event's showcase. However, since then, we've faced events that were both hopeful and challenging. In this text devlog, we'll share those experiences with you.
If you missed our previous devlog, you can watch it before diving into this one:

[previewyoutube=q-ZZWphO4uc;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/214a88bd0c7f3c6c627532753136bb2de8ecfd68.png[/img]

There was a harsh truth: we hadn't actually built a pre-alpha! We had created a vertical slice, meaning there were three levels with no cohesive structure, each showcasing a specific feature of the game. Characters would spawn at the start of a level and enter a doorway at the end, leading to a black screen and loading the next level.

Two problems existed in our vertical slice:

There were no cutscenes or narrative elements, which was a weakness as we claimed our game was strong in narrative.

The vertical slice contained elements that weren't usable in the main game, meaning we had to start building the pre-alpha from scratch. Some implemented systems were also inefficient and had to be discarded, setting us back significantly.

Additionally, our pre-alpha had noticeable bugs. After being accepted into the Digital Dragons event, our lead programmer, Arman, had to focus on fixing these bugs for a month. We couldn't ignore this version because it was the one seen by people and investors at the event. Thus, we began developing the main game levels with only one programmer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/4b42111b0714a5246425ec69d03f4f1e0171076e.png[/img]

Two months after completing the vertical slice, we found ourselves behind schedule and unable to add new team members due to limited resources. Additionally, new members would initially slow down progress as they acclimated to the team, a delay we couldn't afford.

Another unappealing issue with our pre-alpha version was its art style. Not that it was not lovely but , it didn't meet our high expectations because we were aware of our artists' capabilities. We decided to improve the art style, which we are now completely satisfied with and eagerly await sharing new images with you. This improvement, however, disrupted the 3D asset production timeline, extending it beyond our initial anticipations.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/1d92a79dfe1612ef15126de2864f0ec8a6b9ebf6.png[/img]

Starting in July, we had to be in crunch at the studio. This intense focus on the product meant we couldn't create new marketing assets, causing a significant drop in our social media activity.

Our next deadline, set by our publisher, is Gamescom 2024!
Yes, we will be there with a new trailer showcasing new scenes and our progress, but that's not enough! We must also present a playable demo polished with all our graphical assets, music, and sound effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/74815afa33debeaa96e24a218e27ac643b63c03c.jpg[/img]

This is the most critical deadline we've had in this project, and we've never had the opportunity to participate in Gamescom before, even in our previous projects. This is our chance to showcase our abilities. This opportunity, while motivating, also increases our workload and stress as we are behind on our milestones.

However, through the hard work and unity of every team member, we've managed to catch up on many delayed tasks and are getting closer to our next deadline's goals. We are eager to participate in this event and showcase our progress. We will soon resume our marketing activities and provide you with new project updates.

Wishing success to all game development teams who work with their hearts for their games ❤️🍄

What mistakes did you make while creating the initial version of your game? Let's talk about them so no one else repeats them!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/5abe412a00fb29c882c914883cf27f8fc0b34bc9.jpg[/img]

By the way, this little girl you see is from the Sentinel race of Weeny Wise. We will tell you more about her soon. Can you guess her story or name?

notes.title: The story of Palettes' WIZ, An Artistic Challenge That We Held
notes.notes:
After researching our target audience and those who might like our game, we discovered that a significant portion consists of artists. Artists who view games as a work of art, immerse themselves in the game world, bond with the characters, and pay attention to even the smallest details. Therefore, we decided to organize a challenge for artists to have some fun and also test their skills in competition with other artists.

We discussed the challenge and how to conduct it and named it "Palettes' WIZ." The name means "elite of the Palettes" and also derives from "wizard," which relates to magic and our game's world. For prizes, we considered Steam keys, action figures of the characters, and keychains of the game characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883405/026a2d60738aeab4febe539c8dcc2beb82e3808c.png[/img]

For the challenge theme, many might have been confused since our game hasn't been published yet and there wasn't  much information available. So, we decided to fully define the creatures called "Weeny Wises" to make it clear for the artists interested in participating.

The challenge started on May 17th and continued until June 2nd. The participation surprised us, as we expected a maximum of 10 entries but received over 20 (some artists shared more than one work)! Artists who had been following our Instagram page were well acquainted with our characters and the world of Weeny Wises and shared stunning works with us. However, artists less familiar with the game, despite our efforts, still did not fully understand the challenge theme and submitted titles that, although beautiful, were irrelevant.

After receiving the entries, we held a voting on our Instagram page so the community itself could select the best artist among the approved entries for the final round. The engagement on this post was significant, with over 200 comments (we had asked people to choose their preferred artist in the comments). The voting concluded on Sunday, June 9th, and the selected artists were as follows:

1. Miss Far
2. Fatemeh Rahimi
3. Fatemeh Jerengi

This event and its results gave us more hope to pay closer attention to our game's world and characters because no detail escapes the sharp eyes of cinematic platformer game fans!

Here you can see some of the selected works from the Palette's Wiz challenge.

notes.title: Our journey from the beginning to our first international event | Devlog #1
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Weeny Wise has been approved to participate in the Digital Dragons Indie Showcase! This is a great honor for our newly established studio. 
 
In our latest devlog, we will summarize the key challenges and learnings from our journey of creating Weeny Wise, including the process of preparing a reveal trailer and a 20-minute pre-alpha version in just 5 months. 
 
[previewyoutube=q-ZZWphO4uc;full][previewyoutube=q-ZZWphO4uc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[/previewyoutube] 

We would love to hear your thoughts on the game and the development process. Please share what parts you found interesting, where you think we could have done better, and any suggestions for improvement. 
 
Weeny Wise is a co-op, puzzle platformer adventure game where you embark on a magical journey with your companion. Invite a friend to join you for free in the world of Weeny Wises using the Friend's Pass feature and continue the story of Anneli and Hugo.
